title: Dreamtime Bestowed

outfit_card.silhouette: Voluminous fairytale mini ballgown silhouette featuring a sculpted corset bodice, layered iridescent crinoline, oversized sheer back bustle bow, and detached ruffled cuffs.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: Twin crystalline heart tiaras nestled in satin bows, cascading pearl strand garlands, and a floating halo of beaded ribbons and starburst sparkles.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: Strapless iridescent ruffled organza sweetheart neckline over an embroidered pink corset, accented with a jeweled heart brooch, pearl shoulder swags, and detached gathered opera sleeves.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: Voluminous tiered glitter tulle mini skirt framed by scalloped pink overskirts, complemented by sheer lace ankle wraps and pearl-embellished translucent ribbon platform heels.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: A magical pearlescent horned unicorn mount, trailing gossamer rainbow sashes, floating luminous bubbles, and delicate confectionery dreamscape accents.
